'use strict';

require('mocha');
var assert = require('assert');
var author = require('./');

describe('author:', function() {
  it('should return empty fields for missing properties', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(author(''), {});
  });

  it('should return a parsed author object', function() {
    var fixture = 'Jon Schlinkert <jon@example.com> (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {
        name: 'Jon Schlinkert',
        email: 'jon@example.com',
        url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'
      }
    );
  });

  it('should return name and email only', function() {
    var fixture = 'Jon Schlinkert (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {name: 'Jon Schlinkert', url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should handle trailing whitespace', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('Jon Schlinkert '),
      {name: 'Jon Schlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should handle empty url placeholders', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(author(' ()'), {});
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('Jon Schlinkert ()'),
      {name: 'Jon Schlinkert'}
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('<jon.schlinkert@example.com> ()'),
      {email: 'jon.schlinkert@example.com'}
    );
  });

  it('should handle empty email placeholders', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(author('<>'), {});
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('Jon Schlinkert <>'),
      {name: 'Jon Schlinkert'}
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('<> (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)'),
      {url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should handle empty email and url placeholders', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(author('<> ()'), {});
  });

  it('should handle missing name property', function() {
    var fixture = '<jon@example.com> (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {email: 'jon@example.com', url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should handle misordered properties', function() {
    var fixture = '(https://github.com/jonschlinkert) <jon@example.com>';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {email: 'jon@example.com', url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should return name only', function() {
    assert.deepEqual(
      author('Jon Schlinkert'),
      {name: 'Jon Schlinkert'}
    );
  });

  it('should return email only', function() {
    var fixture = '<jon@example.com>';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {email: 'jon@example.com'}
    );
  });

  it('should return url only', function() {
    var fixture = '(https://github.com/jonschlinkert)';
    assert.deepEqual(
      author(fixture),
      {url: 'https://github.com/jonschlinkert'}
    );
  });
});
